description: House adverts for web games, Mini Apps and Telegram bots. No ad network, no tracking, one JSON feed.
lead: House adverts for web games, Mini Apps, Telegram bots and channels.
tags: No ad network · no tracking · one JSON feed
card1Text: Adverts for your channels, projects and partners, managed in a Telegram bot: texts per language, link, image, schedule and weight.
card2Text: Placements register themselves and pick the content they publish (news, gaming, tech …). Their feed only carries adverts for that content.
card3Text: Colour presets or your own colours, as a card, banner or poster. On the web it’s themable with CSS variables.
card4Text: Views, clicks and completed rewarded views as daily totals per advert and placement. No IP addresses, no profiles, no cookies.
step2: Name your site, Mini App, bot or channel and pick the content you publish.
step3: Use the feed URL the bot gives you with one of the packages below. /stats shows how it’s going.
legalText: Adverts have to be recognisable as adverts (in Germany § 6 DDG and § 5a UWG), so the renderers label them „Anzeige“ by default. The feed and the statistics hold no personal data. If you load the feed straight from a visitor’s browser, their IP address reaches the feed server for that request, but it isn’t logged or stored. To keep even that off, fetch the feed on your own server.
adsHint: Adverts your placement can show. New ones start paused.
noPlacements: No placements yet. Register one in the bot with /register.
loginLead: The advert manager uses your Telegram account. Open it from @litfass_advertisement_bot — the bot passes a signed launch to the app, so no password is needed.
loginHint: Or use the bot’s menu button, then choose “Manage adverts”.
error404Body: The link may be old, or the page may have moved. The posters are still here.
error401Body: Open the manager from the Telegram bot to sign in.
error500Body: The server had a bad moment. Try again in a little while.
errorGenericBody: The page could not be loaded ({status}).
signInContinue: Sign in to manage your adverts.
privacyNote: No ad network. No cookies. Only your own adverts.
manageHint: Manage your adverts, placements and statistics.
paidHint: One-time activation and 1 Star per click. The placement receives the click Star.
freeHint: Free — only for placements that allow it.
guideLead: Pick the path that fits your project. Every advert comes from you – no ad network.
guide1Title: Bot in a group or channel
guide1Text: Add @litfass_advertisement_bot as an admin with permission to send messages. Send /post to publish a live advert.
guide1Step1: Add the bot to your group or channel
guide2Text: Fetch the feed, pick an advert and render it. The reporter sends views and clicks back.
guide3Text: Load the feed with the Python package, send the advert to a chat and report events.
feedHint: For custom integrations: send /register in a private chat with the bot to get your feed URL.
videoHint: Paste a Telegram channel post URL — litfass resolves the media from the post.
taskHint: The bot must be a member of that channel so the join can be verified.
notJoined: Not a member yet — join the channel and try again.
botMissing: The bot must be a member of that chat to verify.
